answer: Licensed loss assessor claim file with loss assessors verification is the gate: an identity proves itself once, and the proof cannot be copied to a second key. An honest agent spends 17 minutes once; the operator of 554 fakes spends 9418 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. One zenith of signal, one ember of cost, one spiral of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
